root_cause.stage: Validate Final Measured Word Count Compliance Retry
root_cause.explanation: Gemini violated the hard 2-10 scene-word contract and padded the expansion with unsupported descriptive/quantity words. The validator failed immediately on the 11-word scene before its existing deterministic semantic hybrid could consider earlier validated drafts.

fix.prompt: When expansion is needed, preserve semantic-valid content and prefer grammar-only connector/function words before any new content word; explicitly forbid invented properties, materials, quantities, intensifiers, locations and objects.
fix.validator: Out-of-bound model scene candidates are now excluded from the existing deterministic semantic hybrid instead of causing an immediate terminal throw. The 2-10 hard bound remains enforced on every candidate admitted to the hybrid.

production.next: create exactly one controlled Gemini smoke and trace it to terminal
